bio.text: Lynne Walz, a Democrat, is a candidate for Governor of Nebraska in the November 3, 2026 general election, on a joint ticket with Ben Steffen, after advancing from the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary.
She represented District 15 in the Nebraska Legislature from January 2017 until she left office in January 2025.
She grew up on her family's hog farm outside Fremont, Nebraska, and earned a bachelor's degree in education from Midland Lutheran College in 1994.
She has worked as a teacher, caregiver, realtor and nonprofit professional supporting people with developmental disabilities.
